# Hell King Scythe (Fabric 1.21.1)

## Jar kaise banayein
1. Java 21 install karo (https://adoptium.net).
2. Windows: `build.bat` double-click. Mac/Linux: `./build.sh`.
3. Jar milega: `build/libs/hellking-scythe-1.0.0.jar` (sources wali jar mat lena).
   (Pehli baar 5-10 min lagte hain, internet chahiye.)

Ya GitHub par upload karo -> Actions tab -> build -> Artifacts se jar download.

## Install
Minecraft 1.21.1 + Fabric Loader 0.16+ + Fabric API (1.21.1) -> jar ko `mods` folder mein daalo.

## Use
- Recipe: `NNS / _B_ / _B_` (N = Netherite Ingot, S = Nether Star, B = Blaze Rod). Creative > Combat tab mein bhi hai.
- Scythe haath mein pakdo, **V** dabao -> Hell King transformation (2 sec charge).
- **F** = devil flight toggle, **G** (hold) = flame beam, **R** = fireball, **V** = wapas normal.
- Keys Options > Controls > "Hell King Scythe" mein badal sakte ho.
